dedupeResult: The active pull-request dataset was searched for both station names, call signs, domains, canonical submission paths and the plaintext KAOS Music Department mailbox before insertion. No prior Radio K or KAOS canonical opportunity was found. Radio K's Contact page, dedicated first-party submission link, protected Music Director action, separate Off The Record contact and general/request addresses were consolidated into one record; only the dedicated music-submission route was queued. KAOS's Submit Music, Contact and Staff pages, Music Department mailbox, physical address and adjacent general contact form were consolidated into one record; only the authorized digital-link and physical music routes were queued.
emailVerificationLevel: Radio K publishes a purpose-bound Music Director email action and a dedicated first-party How to Submit Music link, but the underlying destination was not exposed in plaintext and was not decoded, guessed or stored. KAOS repeatedly publishes kaosmusicdirector@gmail.com on official first-party pages for Music Department submissions; verification covered valid syntax, explicit purpose, cross-page consistency and current station activity, while noting that Gmail is an external domain. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, form, attachment, stream, download link, one-sheet, metadata, physical package, login, CAPTCHA, consent, identity claim, rights declaration or payment was sent. The inaccessible Radio K instructions were not worked around, its protected destination was not decoded, and the Off The Record, request and general contacts were not used as substitutes. KAOS's adjacent general form and general mailboxes were not used for music. No anti-bot, authentication, payment or platform restriction was entered or bypassed. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
